method.aggregation: weighted geometric mean (non-compensatory); additive mean reported as aci_additive

earth_floor.note: No Earth site reaches lunar or Martian conditions, so environmental targets are clipped to the most extreme values reachable on Earth's land surface. Environmental similarity therefore means 'as close as Earth gets', never 'equal'.

method.robustness: 1000 random draws: Dirichlet dimension weights around the defaults and terrain tolerance scales of 0.5x, 1x or 2x.

data.earth_elevation: AWS Terrain Tiles zoom 11 (SRTM/NASADEM/ArcticDEM composite), resampled to 120 m
data.moon_elevation: LRO LOLA 20 m south-polar DEM, block-averaged to 120 m
data.mars_elevation: MGS MOLA 463 m global DEM, bilinearly resampled to 120 m (baselines >= 960 m only)
data.climate: NASA POWER climatology (0.5 deg reanalysis; coarse for point sites)
data.geology: Curated expert priors in catalog/earth_sites.json and catalog/targets.json

tag_vocabulary.fluvial_paleo: Paleo-channels, alluvial fans, dry lake beds
tag_vocabulary.alteration: Hydrothermal, acid-saline, clay or sulfate alteration

irreducible_gaps.note: Conditions Earth cannot reproduce at any location, so field campaigns must use simulation, chambers or parabolic flight for these.

moon.other: Near-vacuum, permanently shadowed regions below ~40 K, no magnetic field, abrasive electrostatically charged dust.
moon.sources: Chang'E-4 LND (Zhang et al., 2020, Science Advances); Diviner cold traps (Paige et al., 2010, Science)

mars.other: CO2 atmosphere, perchlorate-bearing regolith, global dust storms, mean temperature near -60 C.

sites.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay)
sites.heritage: Mars-like soils with extremely low organic content and a dry limit of microbial life (Navarro-Gonzalez et al., 2003, Science).
sites.limits: Air pressure ~90 kPa, versus ~0.6 kPa on Mars and none on the Moon; Earth gravity; intense coastal fog and rare rain events have no Mars equivalent.

sites.limits: Volcanism here is mostly andesitic, not basaltic; pressure still ~55-60 kPa; summer rains and snow.

sites.limits: Only a ~23 km, ~39 Myr old impact structure; Earth gravity and atmosphere; 24 h summer daylight and biologically active tundra.

sites.limits: Atmosphere ~100x thicker than Mars; summer melt-water streams and lakes; remote logistics; strong environmental protection rules.
